bug_info.bug_desc: In flash_phy_rd.sv, the read buffer re-allocation arbiter u_valid_random uses ready_i(req_o & no_match). req_o is the flash read-stage request, but it is not qualified by ack_i, which is the flash primitive's request-acceptance handshake. If ack_i is deasserted, req_o can remain high for multiple cycles, causing the arbiter to treat each cycle as a completed handshake and advance allocation/selection even though no flash request was actually accepted. This can skip or under-utilize valid read buffer entries, effectively reducing the number of usable buffers. The same incorrect ready_i expression appears in both the template and ip_autogen copies of the module.
bug_info.fix_hint: Qualify the arbiter ready input with the actual flash request acceptance handshake by changing ready_i from req_o & no_match to req_o & ack_i & no_match. This ensures buffer allocation/selection only advances when the flash macro truly accepts the request, preserving correct and fair buffer usage. Apply the same change in both hw/ip_templates/flash_ctrl/rtl/flash_phy_rd.sv and hw/top_earlgrey/ip_autogen/flash_ctrl/rtl/flash_phy_rd.sv.
